answer_1.quote: SciEx contains answers produced by 7 LLMs on the exam questions... we created the benchmark by evaluating the performance of LLMs on university computer science exams.
answer_1.outputs: Freeform exam answers (text, optionally describing images)

answer_2.quote: We also provide automatic grading using LLM-as-a-judge, so that we can evaluate future LLMs on SciEx... achieving 0.948 Pearson correlation to expert grading.

answer_3.quote: In addition to expert grading, we also provide automatic grading using LLM-as-a-judge... we use the stronger models, i.e., Mixtral, Llama3 and GPT-4V, to conduct the grading.

answer_4.quote: We then give the LLM answers back to the lecturers, who proceed with grading the LLM output the same way they would grade student answers.
answer_4.guideline: Lecturers grade the LLM output using the same criteria and grading scale as for student answers.
